summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of NEW multi-image gallery, video display, and clickable orders features. All 13 features tested successfully. Storefront product modal shows image gallery with 3 thumbnails + video Play button for prod-1. Clicking thumbnails changes main image. Video thumbnail shows YouTube embed. Homepage ProductModal has same gallery + video functionality. Dashboard product form shows multi-image preview grid with delete buttons on hover, video URL input field. Dashboard product detail modal shows gallery with thumbnails + video. Orders tab rows are clickable via data-testid='order-row-{id}' and open order detail modal with customer info, items, and status controls. Regression tests passed: cart + checkout flow works, category-grouped display works.

issues: Console warning: DialogContent requires DialogTitle for accessibility - recommend adding VisuallyHidden DialogTitle
